services.title: Services
services.heading: Comprehensive growth solutions for your business
services.intro: Five service groups designed to support your business through every stage: strategy, personal branding, standardized operations, and digital platform rollout.

items.title: Marketing - Sales - Customer Care System Consulting & Deployment
items.description: Build an integrated Marketing - Sales - Customer Care system so your business grows in a controlled way, instead of running disconnected, strategy-less marketing efforts.

items.title: Personal Branding for Business Owners
items.description: Position and grow the business owner's personal brand — the most durable competitive asset in an era where customers trust people before products.

items.title: SOP Standardization & Team Training
items.description: Systematize operating procedures (SOPs) and train teams for real-world execution, so the business runs steadily even without the owner's direct supervision.

items.title: SME OS Digital Platform Rollout

about.title: About the Founder
about.name: Tang Tri Duc
about.heading: Building and standing beside SMEs
about.quote: Free the owner. Elevate the business.
about.bodyIntro: Tang Tri Duc is the founder of Tri Duc Car Media — a firm that consults, provides, designs and operates Marketing, Communications, Sales and business optimization services for SMEs and household businesses in Vietnam.
about.body1: Starting with growth solutions for the Automotive Services industry, Tang Tri Duc built hands-on experience designing Marketing - Sales - Customer Care systems for small and medium businesses — where owners often have to wear every hat themselves.
about.body2Heading: Expanding the model to every SME sector
about.body2: From that foundation, Tri Duc Car Media grew into a comprehensive partner for SMEs and household businesses across many industries, guided by one consistent philosophy: every business needs a properly designed operating system, not an owner carrying everything alone.
about.body3: No off-the-shelf packages — every business is diagnosed individually, given its own roadmap, and supported directly by the founder at the moments that matter most.
about.value1Body: No handing off to junior staff — the founder is directly involved in strategic advising.
about.value2Body: Every solution is designed as a repeatable SOP, not dependent on any one person.
about.value3Body: Long-term systems are prioritized over short-lived campaigns without foundation.
